headline: Indian stock markets crash as Sensex tumbles 1,484 points and Nifty falls below 25,350

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Heavy selling pressure in banking and metal shares dragged benchmark indices lower.
India VIX spiked nearly 8%, reflecting rising market volatility and heightened fear.
Reversal in the rupee and rising debt supply created additional drag in a holiday-shortened week.
Weak cues and market sell-offs led to investor losses of over Rs 6 lakh crore.
whatHappening: Sensex plunged 1,484 points while Nifty dropped below the 25,350 mark during market trading.
RBI maintained capital requirements as SBI, HDFC Bank, and ICICI Bank retained D-SIB status.
Adani Airport Holdings raised ₹2,790 crore ($300 million) from 360 ONE Asset.
Tata Steel committed to reducing debt at APL Apollo while keeping the company listed following a 21% crash.
summary: Indian stock markets experienced a sharp sell-off on Monday, with the Sensex crashing over 1,480 points and Nifty falling below 25,350. Heavy selling in banking and metal shares alongside an 8% surge in India VIX wiped out over Rs 6 lakh crore of investor wealth. Meanwhile, RBI retained D-SIB status for SBI, HDFC Bank, and ICICI Bank, while Adani Airport raised ₹2,790 crore from 360 ONE Asset.
